name: presales-studio
description: Turns a security questionnaire into a client-ready proposal: NIST CSF gap analysis, quantified risk, budget-constrained roadmap, ROI, compliance coverage and architecture diagram, in English or Spanish. Numbers are computed, never generated by an LLM. Zero runtime dependencies.
